message: そこにいない君

name: Synn
message: 「We're still getting ready, yet it looks like quite a few people have already come to check things out」

name: Ria
message: 「That's because KiraFes got such great reviews」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, everyone in Ryuusei Town loves festivals」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been wondering about something for a while now, though」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I bet it's some stupid question」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's hear her out before we judge」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though it's the Holy Night Festival, why do we hold it starting in the morning?」

name: Misa
message: 「Asking something so fundamental at this point...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Obviously because festivals are fun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's so half-assed」
Well, it's actually because we have preparations to do.

name: Sally
message: 「Aah, I wanna enjoy the festival too! This is so booooring」

name: Misa
message: 「Why don't you just go enjoy it, then?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm the most important member of the Student Council, you know. I can't just goof around」
At such an outrageous claim, everyone was momentarily struck speechless.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Omake hasn't worked at all--

name: Lolotte
message: mmph, mmph」
Covering Lolotte's mouth,

name: Synn
message: 「U-uh, look, Sally-chan worked really hard on all the prep work up till now, so you can go play today!」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, if the Prez says so, I have no choice! See ya! I'm gonna go have fun!」

name: Misa
message: 「She's sure quick at times like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone else, make sure you have fun too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha, abso-posi-tively!」

name: Ria
message: 「First up, Synn-kun is on break, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」
I picked up the digital camera Azel had been using.
I have to take plenty of pictures for Azel's sake too.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief, Azel-san really is foolish. To think he wouldn't participate in such a fun festival...」
A slightly heavy silence fell over the Student Council room.
Everyone is worried about Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. He'll make it in time for the final dance.」
Seeing photos of every single student lined up in neat rows was a magnificent sight.
Everyone looked so full of life that you could tell what kind of person they were just by looking at their photo.
That's how it felt.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Ah, found my photo! Aahn, I'm so gorgeous!」
All around, the voices of students delighted at finding their own photos
It seems to be quite well-received.
Of course it is.
After all, Azel loves everyone.
I wonder how long I stood there looking at the photos like that.

name: Melilot
message: 「So this is where you were.」
When I heard that voice, Melilot-san and I were the only ones left in the exhibition hall.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't you think they're great photos?」
Melilot-san gazed at the photos for a little while.

name: Melilot
message: 「Technically speaking, they are amateurish... but for such a short period of time, this is impressive.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel definitely loves this world.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I suppose so.」

name: Synn
message: 「How's the area in front of the church?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I put up a barrier so the students wouldn't get close.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the magic circles?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've stripped away seventy percent of their functionality. Once we destroy the last remaining crucial magic circle--the one in the Finis Tower plaza--it will be ninety percent.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I underestimated Soltia's skill. To think she altered the patterns of every single one of these numerous magic circles.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Anyone carrying a wish they can't fulfill is desperate, man」
Soltia--Ms. Sengen'in--I didn't know what wish she wanted to fulfill badly enough to side with Re-Crea.
However, even though we couldn't see eye to eye, just like Bylous, she must have been harboring something maddening inside her as well.

name: Melilot
message: 「Whether I can destroy it in time is a difficult question, but I will do my absolute best」

name: Melilot
message: 「So that Sakura-kun and Azel-san can talk for as long as possible」

name: Synn
message: 「...Thank you very much」

name: Melilot
message: 「Depending on how the conversation goes, you might be able to remove Re-Crea from Azel-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Melilot
message: 「I do not know precisely when or why Re-Crea came to dwell within Azel-san. However」

name: Melilot
message: 「At the moment it took root, there was likely no discrepancy between Azel-san's wish and Re-Crea's wish--though I am not sure one can call the will of a god a wish」

name: Synn
message: 「To destroy the world and remake it, you mean」

name: Melilot
message: 「Only the remaking held meaning for her, I imagine. Because she did not love the world she was going to destroy」

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea and Azel-san resonated deeply and assimilated」

name: Synn
message: 「But right now」
Melilot-san nodded.

name: Melilot
message: 「Have you ever encountered a moment where Azel-san suddenly began suffering in pain?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it... a few times」
Since she was asking, Melilot-san had probably witnessed it herself too.

name: Melilot
message: 「Was that not when Azel-san was showing a favorable reaction toward this world, or toward the people of this world?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Now that you mention it, maybe so」

name: Paqy
message: 「No doubt about it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could that not have been a rejection reaction?」

name: Synn
message: 「Between Azel's will and Re-Crea's will?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely. Loving this world and regretting its destruction could be called rebellion against the will of Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Then if Azel completely rejects Re-Crea...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The rejection reaction might cause them to separate」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't exactly feel comfy for a god, after all.」
It was supposed to be something to be happy about.
Yet even without reaching complete denial, she had looked to be in so much agony.
If she went all the way, how severe would the pain be?
Besides.

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't that... be denying almost everything Azel has lived for up until now?」
She believed firmly in God.
She had disciplined her entire life around that faith, living in obedience to it.
It would mean forcing her to admit that all of it had been wrong.
A ripple of emotion akin to pain appeared on Melilot's face.

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so... isn't that a better choice than her destroying the very world and people she loves with her own hands?」
Her voice sounded as though she were trying to convince herself.

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides... what I fear is that she might take her own life.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」
No. It was possible.
Because Azel had told only me the exact moment she would be at her weakest before leaving.
The sounds of the Holy Night Festival seemed to fade into the distance.
Only Melilot's voice echoed in my ears.

name: Melilot
message: 「Harming Azel from the outside is virtually impossible. Until Re-Crea fulfills its purpose, it will automatically protect her as its vessel.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So Azel's gonna do herself in?」
Melilot nodded.
The vessel would break, and Re-Crea, losing its host, would likely vanish.
However, Azel wouldn't make it out unscathed either.
Just like the hosts defeated by the Demon Lord...

name: Synn
message: 「B-But is something like that even possible? Azel's own Spirit Power would be controlled by Re-Crea, wouldn't it? And an ordinary weapon--」

name: Melilot
message: 「In theory, it is possible if she seizes and uses a weapon that manifests when a Crusader transforms.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then... if we had transformed in front of Azel」

name: Melilot
message: 「The world might have been saved. At least in the end, that is.」
